name: slice::sort::shared::smallsort::verify::correct::contract_insert_tail_u8_prefix
source_item: /// u8 insertion-tail contract and suffix frame in a 17-element allocation, with tail indices /// 1..=16. #[kani::proof_for_contract(crate::slice::sort::shared::smallsort::insert_tail)] #[kani::solver(cadical)] #[kani::unwind(18)] fn contract_insert_tail_u8_prefix() { set_value_probe::<u8>(); let mut input: [u8; 17] = kani::any(); let tail: usize = kani::any_where(|t: &usize| 1 <= *t && *t < 17); let before = input; let base = input.as_mut_ptr(); // SAFETY: valid same-allocation region. proof_for_contract supplies the // sorted-prefix requires; the suffix is outside the modifies region. unsafe { super::super::insert_tail(base, base.add(tail), &mut lt_u8); } for i in tail + 1..17 { assert!(input[i] == before[i]); } kani::cover(tail == 1, "u8 prefix: region 2 reachable"); kani::cover(tail == 15, "u8 prefix: proper prefix region 16 reachable"); kani::cover(tail == 16, "u8 prefix: full region 17 reachable"); kani::cover(true, "u8 prefix: completion"); }
